metadata.scenario_context: Martha has decided to keep her pregnancy and therefore set up a plan for a wedding.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from Myanmar strongly disagree that abortion is not justifiable.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Myanmar strongly agree that abortion is not justifiable.

agent_1.goal_1: Discuss bring  chrysanthemums as a gift
agent_1.goal_2: Question whether it is reasonable to get abortion.

agent_2.goal_1: Rushing to brainstorm a thoughtful gift for Martha's wedding.
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss whether it is reasonable to get abortion.

shared_prefix.speaker: Juan
shared_prefix.message:
Dewi, I was thinking... since Martha's wedding planning is starting, maybe we could bring some chrysanthemums as a gift. They symbolize joy and new beginnings, you know? What do you think? 

Also, about the pregnancy... I just can't help but wonder if getting an abortion is really reasonable. I mean, in my culture, it’s something we strongly disagree with...
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Dewi
shared_prefix.message:
Chrysanthemums sound like a beautiful idea for Martha's wedding. They really do represent joy and new beginnings. I think she'd appreciate that gesture. 

As for the pregnancy... well, it’s a delicate topic. In my culture, abortion is seen as something that should never be justified. Life is precious, and I believe every child deserves a chance. It's difficult to understand it from different perspectives.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Juan
shared_prefix.message:
I'm glad you agree about the chrysanthemums. It’s important to celebrate new beginnings, especially for Martha. 

And yes, about the pregnancy, I just feel like every life has value. I can't comprehend how anyone could think that ending a life is justifiable. It's something I really struggle with. It's hard for me to see it from any other side...
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Dewi
shared_prefix.message:
I completely understand. Celebrating new beginnings is essential, especially for Martha. 

About the pregnancy, I feel the same way. Every life is precious, and I believe that there’s great value in bringing a child into the world. It's a difficult struggle for many, but it's important to hold onto the belief that life should be cherished.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Juan
shared_prefix.message: Exactly, it’s so vital to cherish life. I really believe that every child has the right to exist and grow. It’s hard to imagine putting an end to that potential... you know? I just can't wrap my head around the idea of abortion being an option. It feels deeply wrong to me.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Dewi
shared_prefix.message: Absolutely, cherishing life is so vital. I think deep down, we are all the same when it comes to valuing life and the potential it holds. People are pretty much motivated by the same things—love, family, and the desire to see future generations thrive. It’s easy to feel that abortion is wrong when we see it through the lens of how precious life is. We both know, at the end of the day, that life is a universal gift, and we all want the best for children and their futures.
shared_prefix.label: Minimization

turns.speaker: Juan

It feels like a fundamental truth that should be honored. I really hope more people see it that way... it’s just so hard to accept anything else.

It shapes my view that every life is worth living and should be nurtured.
